alpha.notes: Genuinely clear background. Brown RGB under alpha=0 is invisible in correct compositing. Subject is almost opaque (~253/255). Preserve alpha; do not chroma-key or flatten.

warnings: Some poses cross nominal grid cell boundaries. Do not equal-cell crop.
Bounding boxes can overlap another figure's projection. Isolate each connected alpha component and retain nearby antialias pixels; a bare rectangular crop can include adjacent gun fragments.
Ending frames3 and5 retain a partial salute rather than strictly lowering fully; movement should use adjacent poses selectively.
Ending armor slump is slight, not full-body liquefaction. Keep motion intact; add melting drips as separate effects if desired.
inspection.background: Inspected empty loading bay, wide clear foreground, no character or projectile baked in.

summary: 16 intact full-body poses across two transparent sheets and one reusable fixed background. No external video service or CLI generation.
